messages:
Clare (People Ops): Quick note 1 - new manager Devon Park joins Mon. I put together a compact orientation + access checklist for managers (day0 -> week1). Please add gaps. TL;DR below.
Devon Park: Thanks! Quick Qs: laptop on day0? GitHub org access? want an infra buddy for week1.
Eli (IT): If procurement ticket in by Wed we can ship for Day0. We handle Okta/GSuite and GitHub org invites. Please submit this ticket: 
```
Title: New manager device + access - Devon Park
Body:
- Start: 2026-07-06
- Team: Eng - Platform
- Device: Macbook Pro 14 / existing?
- Needs: Okta, GSuite, GitHub org write, AWS staging read, Vault read, SSH key register
- Manager approver: Ravi
```
Eli (IT): Also indicate if you need KMS/HSM view; we need manager approval for prod creds.
Ravi (Infra): I can buddy wk1 for infra walkthroughs. Day2 I'll demo staging cluster, deploy flow, and how we tune batching/caching for demos. For short demo pools, ping #eng-infra with: purpose, region, qps, retention hours.
Sana (Finance): For expense card: email finance@redwood.com with headcount code + manager signoff. Virtual card same-week after approvals; physical card 5-7 days.
Clare (People Ops): Compact checklist: Preboard (3 days out): procurement ticket, headcount code to Finance, Okta invite. Day0 (eve): confirm device tracking # + calendar seats. Day1: 30m 1:1 + access check (Okta/GitHub/AWS), security quickstart, enroll MFA. Day2: infra buddy walkthrough + staging demo. Day3: shadow triage + meet directs. Day4: draft 30/60/90 and tag manager for feedback. Day5: kickoff first ownership task + week1 retro.
onboard-bot: Calendar event created: "Manager Orientation - Day 0" invited: devon.park@redwood.com
Devon Park: MFA done. GitHub invite pending. I'll paste my SSH pubkey in the ticket now. Also will share a short 30/60/90 by Fri.
Eli (IT): GitHub invite sent. If you don't see it check spam and Okta status. For AWS prod access, include justification in infra form and get Ravi's approval.
Ravi (Infra): Filed a quick staging demo fast-path: I'll approve same-day requests <8h if submitted before 4pm PT.
Clare (People Ops): Great 44f I'll follow up to confirm device ETA and close procurement once we have serial #. Welcome Devon! :tada:
